hash_reuse_assumptions: The pinned RH catalog is immutable and its stored digests came from prior byte hashing. Cataloged files remain immutable through preparation and compiler execution; matching presence/size/mtime/ctime permits digest reuse, not a fresh byte read. Postcheck compares lstat/stat metadata and symlink targets without rehashing. This requires truthful filesystem metadata and no privileged or adversarial mutation that preserves/restores all checked stamps.
publication_scope: Exact selected module/source/part pins and edges. Host paths/stamps omitted; canonical relocation remains unchecked.
